name: zclass_world_free_virtual_area_partitions
description: zClass_World::FreeVirtualAreaPartitions frees per-cell child lists, releases owned virtual area grid storage when appropriate, clears grid metadata, and is a no-op when no grid is installed.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/grid source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450e40 validates the early no-grid return, row/column loops over areaGridRows, per-cell childList free and nulling, areaGridExternalOwnership-controlled row/table frees, and clearing of areaGridRows, areaCellSizeX/Z, and grid counts.
The native smoke verifies external row ownership cleanup, childList nulling, grid metadata clearing, and the no-grid no-op return path.
